notes.title: The Great Nerf Update
notes.notes:
Due to reports from players saying that the game is too hard for them, we've decided to nerf the campaign a little. Let us know what you think about new level of difficulty!

Other changes (0.9.2-0.9.8):
- added support for gamepads,
- nerfed fuel deplete ratio,
- reworked turning animation,
- added steam achievements,
- added campaign progress saving system,
- bugfix: quick direction changes no longer result in controls being blocked,
- bugfix: loosing fuel no longer caps max speed,
- bugfix: adjusted fuse box vertical position.
